description: This file defines an enumeration called DirtyFlags within the PdfSharp.Drawing.Pdf namespace. It uses the Flags attribute, indicating it represents a set of flags for tracking changes or states in PDF drawing operations, such as transformation matrix (Ctm), clipping path, line width, line join, miter limit, and stroke/fill status.

classes.name: DirtyFlags
classes.description: An enum representing various dirty flag states for PDF drawing operations, marked with [Flags] for bitwise combination.
